comment: 50 upload users + 10 large-file users + 50 download users against the local Dockerised mock SFTP at 127.0.0.1:2222. The mock self-loops uploads into each user's own outbox/, so download user names mirror upload user names. To target a real server, edit host / port / credentials and increase duration_hours.
